kind: author qualification of maintenance and independent source review of scan disposition

Original trusted workflow completed for at least 65 minutes
Operator identity, never a workflow role

Immutable journal and abandoned ledger window retained before conditional unlock

negative_cases: Missing, altered, oversized or rehashed malformed immutable receipt
Wrong journal request, unknown operation, extra receipt field or non-object response
Running workflow, credentials younger than 65 minutes, wrong operator or stale state
Pending change set on a later inventory page or repeated pagination token
Changed runtime health or failed immutable-receipt write
